name: Hasini Yedla
motivation:
As a student, I am motivated to join as a Commercial Strategy & External Affairs Associate because I want to understand how innovative ideas are transformed into sustainable businesses.
During my early college days, I preferred staying in the background, but the opportunities I took helped me become more confident and improve my communication skills. These experiences encouraged me to step outside my comfort zone and keep growing.
I am interested in learning how business strategies are developed, how customer needs influence decisions, and how communication bridges the gap between technical ideas and business goals.
I believe this role will help me gain practical exposure, broaden my perspective, and prepare me for future opportunities.
expectations:
I don't expect E-Cell to teach me everything about startups in a short time. What I do expect is an opportunity to understand how businesses think and make decisions.
Since I chose the Commercial Strategy & External Affairs role, I want to learn how customer requirements are understood, how business ideas are discussed and validated, and how communication plays an important role in connecting business and technical teams.
As someone who wants to build a career where I can work between business and technology, I hope this experience gives me practical exposure. I also hope it helps me develop the mindset and skills needed to approach real-world problems with a broader perspective.

My interest lies in software development, embedded systems, artificial intelligence, and IoT-based solutions. Through internships and academic projects, I have gained hands-on experience in developing prototypes, integrating hardware with software, and applying machine learning to practical applications. These experiences have strengthened my problem-solving skills and inspired me to continuously learn, innovate, and transform ideas into reliable products that create meaningful impact.
expectations: Through E-Cell and the National Entrepreneurship Challenge, I hope to understand how innovative technical solutions can be transformed into successful products and startups. I look forward to learning about product validation, customer-centric development, business strategy, and teamwork while collaborating with students from diverse backgrounds. My goal is to enhance both my technical and entrepreneurial skills so that I can contribute to building scalable, impactful, and sustainable technology-driven ventures.

name: Chandaka Neelaveni

These experiences have strengthened my problem-solving abilities, communication skills, and confidence in handling real-world challenges. I enjoy working with people, learning from experienced mentors, and contributing innovative ideas that create meaningful impact. Joining E-Cell IIT Bombay is an opportunity to expand my knowledge, collaborate with like-minded individuals, and apply my practical experience to exciting projects. I believe this platform will help me sharpen my leadership, creativity, and strategic thinking while preparing me for future entrepreneurial ventures and professional success.

My goal is to continuously learn, contribute, and make the most of every opportunity that E-Cell offers while building long-term professional relationships and practical experience.
